description: This PHP file defines the TransUnit class within the OrangeHRM installer utility namespace. It encapsulates a translation unit with properties for target and unitId, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: TransUnit
classes.description: Class representing a translation unit with optional target and unitId properties, along with their accessors and mutators.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TransUnit with optional target and unitId values.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unitId of the translation unit.

methods.name: setUnitId
methods.description: Sets the unitId of the translation unit.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Returns the target of the translation unit.

methods.name: setTarget
methods.description: Sets the target of the translation unit.
